items.title: Summer Vacation
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Life is easy when you have nothing to do but have fun. Choose between fashionable, colorful and cheerful skins! Put on summer outfits as you Role-play with friends and enjoy the season in a city resort or a seaside vacation. Wherever you go to get away, make some sweet holiday memories! The best way to enjoy the summer.

+ 8 red hot summertime HD skins

items.title: Cliff Jumpers
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
It feels like you’re flying! Step off the edge and make a splash in Cliff Jumpers skins. Experience danger when you role-play with friends and practice a really extreme sport. Gear up in a wetsuit and helmet and dive straight down or get acrobatic and do a somersault before you hit the water below. Not for the faint of heart!

+ 8 fearless daredevil HD skins

items.title: Nightmare Parkour
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Wake up from a nightmare and find yourself lost inside a strange parkour universe. Can you wake up from this dream? Is it real or just a fantasy?
Follow the storyline, set your checkpoints and search for a way out. Enjoy fun and challenging levels while you explore this very strange place.

=> A unique parkour experience
=> 6 pro HD skins
=> Multiplayer support

items.title: Summer Break Teens
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
School break is here! Say goodbye to winter and have a party on the beach in Summer Break Teens skins. Swim, snorkel, or sunbathe as you role-play with friends and enjoy the perfect summer vacation. Gear up in outfits as colorful as the beautiful spring flowers and soak up the sunlight. Its time to relax and free your mind!

+ 8 stylish teenager HD skins

items.title: Cave Dwellers
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Who lives in caves? Dangerous monsters, that’s who! Scare everybody out of your cave home when you role-play in these skins. Choose from 8 hostile creatures and explore the underground all the way to bedrock.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Delivery Service
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Speedy delivery on its way! If anyone is hungry for pizza or other snacks, role-play with friends and bring the goodies in Delivery Service skins. Get there fast on bike or motorcycle to keep the food fresh. Walk your route, as a postal worker and deliver letters and packages all across the city. Put on your backpack—it’s time to get to work!

+ 8 always on time HD skins

items.title: Beach Surfers
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Play in the sun and sand all day long in Beach Surfers skins. In short sleeves, cool shorts, and sunglasses, have a great time role-playing with friends relaxing at the beach. Will you play a game of beach volleyball or soccer? Or just enjoy sunny days and surf music while you watch the waves swell and roll in?

+ 8 super surf-style HD skins

items.title: Dogs and Robbers
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Bark like a real boss! Get tough and look the part in Dogs and Robbers skins. Lead the pack when you role-play with friends as not so good hounds. Put on the dog and wag your tail with plenty of swagger to plan the next caper. Live dangerously while you pick up some jewels, gold, or ores. And be on the lookout for the law!

+ 8 criminal canine HD skins

items.title: Goat Family
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
This herd needs to be heard! Bleat and baa with your favorite relatives in Goat Family skins. Show off your mom or dad horns when you role-play with friends raising your stubborn but curious kids. You’re sure to butt heads along the way! Groom your beard and look sharp walking through the city or quickly scaling the closest mountain.

+ 8 billy and nanny HD skins

items.title: Teen Style 2021
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Roll with the latest 2021 fashions, and always look your best. Choose from 12 different chic and stylish teenager skins. Short sleeves, long sleeves, hats, jeans, and lots of wonderful colors! Role-play as one of the trendiest teens in the city and make new friends.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Shadow
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Don’t just lurk in the shadows, become them! Choose from 10 different dark skins that will help you blend into the shadows. As you creep around in the darkness, no one will be able to see you. Perfect for role-playing undercover and out of sight!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Family Summer Vacation
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Enjoy a sun-sational summer vacation with the whole family! In awesome Hawaiian shirts and cool summer outfits, role-play having the greatest time ever. Choose from mom, dad, grandparents, kids, and teenagers skins. At the beach or on the road, have some real fun in the sun this summer.

1 free skin included!

items.title: Nether Demons
items.creator: Cynosia
items.description:
Become an extremely fashionable demon with Nether Demons! The fun colors impress your friends and make your outfit fire!

+ 8 skins
+ Great for roleplay
+ Made by Artifact Studios

items.title: Cute Animals
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Wow! These animals are so cute! They look so fresh and cool with two different outfits on each animal. Whether you like cats, birds, foxes, or any other cute animal you can think of, we have a skin that fits your style!

- 12 cute animal skins!
- Each skin has their own trendy outfit!

items.title: Weird Vibes
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Strange things happen around weird people, but sometimes weird is fun! Why be normal, when you can be interesting? You feeling these weird vibes yet?

+ 12 unique role-playing skins

items.title: Hacker Tools
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Hacker Tools is a secret underground base with the most powerful gear in Minecraft. With danger prominent, use hacked items to get an edge! Explore the base and find all the different hacked weapons.

- Modern base design
- Hacked armor, weapons, and blocks with extreme enchantments!
- Tons of decorated rooms to play with friends!

items.title: Scary Mobs
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Wanna scare your friends with mobs? These scary mobs are perfect for scaring your friends!

- 12 unique skins
- 2 free skins!
- Perfect for role-playing
- By Rvan Studios

items.title: Elegant Teens
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Get ready! It’s your moment to shine and walk down the boulevard like a fashion model. Put on the latest trendy garments and stand out from the crowd. Be the most elegant among your friends and express your personality through fashion!

+ 1 free skin
+ 12 teen skins

items.title: Dream Anime Teens
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Anime teenagers have taken over the city! Meet the best dressed teenagers in expensive brands. Spend a great time with them practicing parkour, shopping or playing games. 

Join the Anime Teens group, set a new trend and impress your friends. Let your dreams come true!

items.title: Skyblock Plus 2
items.creator: Tetrascape
items.description:
Skyblock... with a little more fun.
Created by Tetrascape

items.title: Hip Hop HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Crank up the beats and get your dance moves ready with these trendy teens! Bring some of the cool style and fashion of hip hop to your world with this collection. 

+ 18 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Froggy HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
These little frogs are just a skip, hop, and jump away! Dress up in the cutest frog themed fashion for teens and explore your nearest swamp. Perfect style for players who love animals and the color green!

+ 12 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Heroic Legends
items.creator: Ready, Set, Block!
items.description:
Become the ultimate hero! These legends have spent their entire lives training to be the best of the best and now it's time for their skill and prowess to show. Will you rise to the top and become the next Minecraft legend?

+ 12 skins
+ 1 free skin
+ By Ready, Set, Block!

items.title: Corrupted Colors 2
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description:
These dark and corrupted creatures are back more corrupted than ever. Not only are they colorful, but they also look beautiful and scary! Enjoy these colorful yet creepy skin and help them spread the corruption!

- 16 skins
- By: Blu Shutter Bug
